exercises.name: Couch stretch
exercises.note: Back knee against sofa/wall, glute squeezed, torso tall — feel it in the front of the hip, not the lower back

exercises.name: Glute bridge
exercises.note: 2 s squeeze at the top, ribs down, don't arch the lower back

exercises.name: Dead bug
exercises.note: Lower back pressed into the floor

exercises.name: Side plank
exercises.note: On knees if the full version aggravates anything

exercises.name: Standing pelvic tilt
exercises.note: Tuck into POSTERIOR tilt and hold a beat — the tuck is the rep. Practise 'run tall, tuck the pelvis'
